title: Samsung's consumer device chief TM Roh says it was "open to strategic co-operation" with more AI groups, having recently added Perplexity to its mobile OS (Michael Acton/Financial Times)
summary: Michael Acton / Financial Times: Samsung's consumer device chief TM Roh says it was “open to strategic co-operation” with more AI groups, having recently added Perplexity to its mobile OS — Korean giant's device chief says its future Galaxy devices will host multiple models as users mix and match AI tools
